ROTARY CLUB OF MUMBAI MULUND EAST

PROJECT REPORT – SAFE / UNSAFE TOUCH AWARENESS SESSION 6th day of Navrati

Date: 16th October 2026
Time: 8:00 AM onwards
Venue: Nutan Vidyalaya, Nalasopara
Beneficiaries: 750 students
Facilitator: Rtn Shaline Serpes
Joint Project: Rotary Club of Mumbai Mulund East and Rotary Club of Vasai

Objective
To teach girls about safe and unsafe touch, personal boundaries, self-protection, and asking trusted adults for help.

The session covered:
• Safe and unsafe touch
• Recognising inappropriate behaviour
• Saying “NO” confidently
• Speaking up and asking trusted adults for help
